newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Polifarb Debica IPO heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Polifarb Debica IPO heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 9,390,595 shares in Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica SA's 700,000-share initial public offering at 65 zlotys per share, the company said in a statement on Monday.
TRANCHES NO OF SHARES NO OF SHARES ORDERS
The statement also said National Investment Fund No 11, which had a 33-percent stake before the issue, received 200,000 shares in the large investor tranche.
The company has said it seeks an April listing on the Warsaw bourse's main market.
It has said it expects its 1997 net profit to rise to 17 million zlotys on 148.1-million-zloty sales from 1996's net-profit estimate of 12.8 million zlotys on sales of 137.5 million zlotys.
